title: [Student Offer] Optus Sim Only 12M Plan $35/M Unlimited Call/Texts (Incl. International to 35 Countries) + 200GB Data/Month
body:
Deal: [Student Offer] Optus Sim Only 12M Plan $35/M Unlimited Call/Texts (Incl. International to 35 Countries) + 200GB Data/Month

[Dyl] Decent if it includes sub hub and other benefits
[park it] What benefits does Optus offer? Thinking I’m missing something.
[Dyl] 10% off subscriptions (Netflix, prime, etc) and various random promos of free periods (ie 6 months prime).
Requires 3+ eligible subscriptions for the 10% discount, but the random promos are where it’s at.
[Switchblade88] I want 1/10th the data for 1/10th the price… FTTP does all my heavy lifting
[workingsmart] How are people liking optus? My partner switched to optus and feeling its no good. Any thoughts?
[FullPricePhobic] Depends on your location. Overall, it's much better than Vodafone and I get higher 5G speeds compared to my work-provided Telstra.
[naru6705] Much better service where I live compared to Telstra
[p3r514n] Define "no good".
https://insights.opensignal.com/reports/2026/05/australia/mo…
[workingsmart] Feels coverage is not as good, calls drop out on network or connection is spottier than last which i think was voda, funnily enough. Doesnt rate as well!
[tp0] Optus is #1 in the two cities of Australia.
[Mjk698] There's millions of people in the country everyone has different experiences
[drfuzzy] I hate these bait and switch Optus plans - sign you up at an attractive price but the fine print tells you what you'll really be paying unless you churn away
[p3r514n] No lock-in contract
You're paying what it says? $35/m.
[despavr] He knows that .. it’s just the fact that the price will go up exponentially if you don’t cancel in time
[p3r514n] Exponentially? It goes up to $59 and you keep the 100gb data meanwhile everyone else pays $60 for 60gb. If that's unattractive at the time, simply leave.
[R3XNebular] Totally agree, happy to stay with Optus if the plan didn't increase. Currently on $65 plan with 50%, contacted chat and they extended for another year. If not will have to churn.
[Mjk698] How hard is it to remember when the deal ends
[p3r514n] Exactly. They act like it's catastrophic.
[linnkid] This deal only last 12 months, then switch to somewhere at 50/month if I am remember correctly. definately a good deal if you are a student. just remember to switch to another plan with 12 month period ends
[Dyl] Can this be combined with $15/mi data only for data sharing?
There’s also a $5 for 5GB unadvertised plan to replace the old $5 once off data share sims, unsure if chat will allow access to it though.
